supersedes.reason: The v1 two-cycle recovery falsifier fired; four episodes reached three consecutive degraded polls.

runtime_availability_measurement.method: first backend market_candles emission minus one-minute candle close for current-run post-start bars
runtime_availability_measurement.interpretation: SPCX has a distinct finalization tail beyond the common sequential-cycle latency.

evidence: The backend omitted one or two newest SPCX completed minutes and later emitted the exact missing timestamps.
A fresh official candleSnapshot later contained the omitted 21:32, 21:33, and 21:35 UTC rows as zero-volume flat candles.
The local cache retained prior bars and merged the later official rows; no permanent interior loss was found.
The controller refused to synthesize candles, emitted degraded telemetry, attempted no profit-lock order, and preserved the venue stop.

rejected_alternatives.backend_crash: rejected because reconciliation, funding, and later running heartbeats continued
rejected_alternatives.local_cache_loss: rejected because the exact omitted timestamps arrived later and merged into the cache
rejected_alternatives.unprotected_position: rejected because venue stop 517022767203 remained owned and reduce-only
rejected_alternatives.harmless_two_cycle_lag: rejected because four measured episodes lasted three polls

economic_impact_assessment.residual_risk: An activated future lock can be recognized 60-165 seconds late when source publication follows the measured tail.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: Official SPCX candle finalization lag is recoverable but materially longer than the common cohort cycle tail.
falsifiers_or_updates: a candle remains missing after a later official read
an activated lock trigger is delayed or missed
a targeted recovery read cannot reduce the measured tail without rate-limit or routing regressions
the venue stop becomes absent during a source gap

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: A bounded exact-symbol refetch only after a detected tail gap can reduce lock-decision latency without synthesizing data or delaying unrelated exits.
falsifiers_or_updates: recovery reads do not materially improve p95 or p99 availability
the added request budget increases 429 responses or cycle latency
the design can duplicate routing or weaken exact completed-bar identity
an independent event-driven source provides a simpler exact contract

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep the loaded v51 controller and venue stop unchanged; design and test a bounded exact-symbol recovery read for a future revision, with no candle synthesis and no deployment until separately approved.
recommendation.Why now: The two-cycle bounded-lag assumption has been falsified and SPCX p99 availability is roughly 105 seconds versus roughly 38 seconds for the common reference group.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Exact current-run heartbeat prefix, first-availability market-candle telemetry, current bound execution plan and stop, and a fresh official SPCX candleSnapshot.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: The source-honest controller can temporarily lose profit-lock decision availability even while the backend and venue stop remain healthy.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Any open SPCX lifecycle after the 100-bps completed-bar profit-lock activation.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Fabricate flat candles, ignore missing rows, accept next-cycle retry, add a bounded targeted refetch, or replace the source with a separately proven exact event-driven candle contract.
recommendation.Expected upside: Potentially reduce activated-lock decision delay while retaining exact official candle identity.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: API-rate pressure, longer cycles, duplicate routing, a refetch that still precedes publication, or accidental use of a synthetic candle.
recommendation.Validation completed: Root-cause separation, frequency and episode measurement, cross-symbol latency comparison, current activation and stop audit, and official-source recovery confirmation.
recommendation.Validation still required: Test-first callback/retry design, no-duplicate-action proof, bounded-request proof, simulated 429/timeout behavior, exact-source identity preservation, and prospective latency measurement.
recommendation.Success metrics: No fabricated rows; no duplicate action; venue stop always retained; material p95/p99 latency reduction; no added stale-entry or rate-limit incidents.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Any action duplication, source-identity ambiguity, new rate-limit failures, slower unrelated exits, or no meaningful availability improvement.
recommendation.Confidence level: High on diagnosis and current-trade no-impact; low-to-medium on the proposed mitigation until TDD and prospective measurement complete.

limitations: Backend emission time is an upper bound on source availability because it includes the sequential cycle.
The active SPCX trade never activated its profit lock, so no avoided or incurred PnL can be attributed to this incident.
No live source, controller, route, strategy, parameter, sizing, leverage, stop, exit, process, or deployment setting changed.
